commit.message:
Merge pull request #36 from hadarkamer/feature/all-watch-scan-maxpain-20260913

Extend all-Watch research to 82 formulas from frozen MaxPain inputs

checks.query:
SELECT 'runtime' AS section, to_jsonb(r) AS evidence
FROM research_watch_scan_formula_runtime r
UNION ALL
SELECT 'catalog', jsonb_build_object('evaluation_version',evaluation_version,
    'definitions',COUNT(*),'supported',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE supported),
    'feature_versions',jsonb_agg(DISTINCT feature_version))
FROM research_watch_scan_formula_catalog GROUP BY evaluation_version
UNION ALL
SELECT 'jobs',jsonb_build_object('evaluation_version',evaluation_version,'status',status,
    'samples',COUNT(*),'due',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE next_attempt_at_utc<=clock_timestamp()))
FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples GROUP BY evaluation_version,status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'v2_accepted_source_coverage',jsonb_build_object('expected_coin_samples',COUNT(*),
    'ready',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.status='READY'),
    'pending_or_absent',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'READY'))
FROM research_watch_scan_intakes i
CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['BTC','ETH','SOL','BNB','XRP','DOGE','ZEC','HYPE']) coin(symbol)
LEFT JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_samples f
    ON f.consumer_version=i.consumer_version AND f.snapshot_set_id=i.snapshot_set_id
    AND f.symbol=coin.symbol AND f.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v2-maxpain'
WHERE i.consumer_version='watch-all-scan-intake-v1' AND i.intake_status='ACCEPTED'

SELECT 'current_evaluations' AS relation,evaluation_version,COUNT(*) AS rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE evaluation_version IS DISTINCT FROM
        (SELECT active_evaluation_version FROM research_watch_scan_formula_runtime WHERE singleton)) AS wrong_version
FROM research_watch_scan_formula_evaluations GROUP BY evaluation_version
UNION ALL
SELECT 'evaluations_by_version',evaluation_version,COUNT(*),0
FROM research_watch_scan_formula_evaluations_by_version GROUP BY evaluation_version
UNION ALL
SELECT 'current_population',evaluation_version,COUNT(*),
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE evaluation_version IS DISTINCT FROM
        (SELECT active_evaluation_version FROM research_watch_scan_formula_runtime WHERE singleton))
FROM research_watch_scan_formula_wave_population GROUP BY evaluation_version
UNION ALL
SELECT 'population_by_version',evaluation_version,COUNT(*),0
FROM research_watch_scan_formula_wave_population_by_version GROUP BY evaluation_version

WITH sample AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v2-maxpain' AND status='READY'
    ORDER BY snapshot_set_id DESC,symbol LIMIT 512
), paired AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT n.consumer_version,n.snapshot_set_id,n.symbol,n.payload AS new_payload,o.payload AS old_payload
    FROM sample n LEFT JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_samples o
      ON o.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v1' AND o.status='READY'
      AND (o.consumer_version,o.snapshot_set_id,o.symbol)=(n.consumer_version,n.snapshot_set_id,n.symbol)
), old_decisions AS (
    SELECT p.consumer_version,p.snapshot_set_id,p.symbol,e.value AS decision
    FROM paired p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.old_payload->'evaluations') e
), new_decisions AS (
    SELECT p.consumer_version,p.snapshot_set_id,p.symbol,p.old_payload IS NOT NULL AS has_v1,e.value AS decision
    FROM paired p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.new_payload->'evaluations') e
    JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_catalog c ON c.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v1'
      AND c.candidate_key=e.value->>'candidate_key' AND c.supported
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paired) AS v2_samples_checked,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paired WHERE old_payload IS NOT NULL) AS overlapping_samples,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paired WHERE old_payload IS NULL) AS samples_without_v1,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE n.has_v1) AS overlapping_legacy_decisions,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE n.has_v1 AND n.decision IS DISTINCT FROM o.decision) AS changed_or_missing_legacy_decisions
FROM new_decisions n LEFT JOIN old_decisions o
  ON (o.consumer_version,o.snapshot_set_id,o.symbol)=(n.consumer_version,n.snapshot_set_id,n.symbol)
  AND o.decision->>'candidate_key'=n.decision->>'candidate_key'
  AND o.decision->>'base_direction'=n.decision->>'base_direction'

WITH sample AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v2-maxpain' AND status='READY'
    ORDER BY snapshot_set_id DESC,symbol LIMIT 512
), inputs AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT f.consumer_version,f.snapshot_set_id,f.symbol,f.payload,o.maxpain_slots,o.sources
    FROM sample f JOIN research_watch_scan_observations o USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol)
), slots AS (
    SELECT i.consumer_version,i.snapshot_set_id,i.symbol,s.value,
        array_position(ARRAY['12h','24h','48h','3d','1w','2w','1m'],s.value->>'timeframe') AS ordinal
    FROM inputs i CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(i.maxpain_slots) s
), averages AS (
    SELECT consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol,value->>'source_side' AS source_side,
      COUNT(*) AS slots,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE value->>'status'='SCORED') AS denominator,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE value->>'status'='INACTIVE_TARGET') AS inactive,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE value->>'status'='MISSING_INPUT') AS missing,
      SUM((value->>'score')::double precision ORDER BY ordinal) FILTER(WHERE value->>'status'='SCORED') AS score_sum,
      jsonb_object_agg(value->>'timeframe',value->'score' ORDER BY ordinal)
        FILTER(WHERE value->>'status'='SCORED') AS timeframe_values
    FROM slots GROUP BY consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol,value->>'source_side'
), source_rows AS (
    SELECT i.consumer_version,i.snapshot_set_id,i.symbol,r.value->>'timeframe' AS timeframe,
      CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.value->'current_price')='number' THEN (r.value->>'current_price')::numeric END AS price,
      CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.value->'short_max_pain')='number' THEN (r.value->>'short_max_pain')::numeric END AS short_target,
      CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.value->'long_max_pain')='number' THEN (r.value->>'long_max_pain')::numeric END AS long_target
    FROM inputs i CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(i.sources->'maxpain_operational_rows') r
), closest AS (
    SELECT *,CASE
      WHEN short_target>price AND (long_target IS NULL OR long_target>=price
          OR short_target-price<=price-long_target) THEN 'SHORT'
      WHEN long_target<price THEN 'LONG'
      ELSE NULL END AS source_side
    FROM source_rows
), consensus AS (
    SELECT consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol,COUNT(*) AS source_rows,
      COUNT(DISTINCT timeframe) AS distinct_timeframes,COUNT(source_side) AS total,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE source_side='LONG') AS long_hits,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE source_side='SHORT') AS short_hits
    FROM closest GROUP BY consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol
), proofs AS (
    SELECT i.consumer_version,i.snapshot_set_id,i.symbol,d.base_direction,
      CASE d.base_direction WHEN 'LONG' THEN 'SHORT' ELSE 'LONG' END AS expected_side,
      i.payload#>ARRAY['maxpain_provenance_by_direction',d.base_direction] AS proof,
      i.payload#>ARRAY['features_by_direction',d.base_direction,'features'] AS features
    FROM inputs i CROSS JOIN (VALUES('LONG'),('SHORT')) d(base_direction)
), joined AS (
    SELECT p.*,a.slots,a.denominator,a.inactive,a.missing,a.score_sum,a.timeframe_values,
      c.source_rows,c.distinct_timeframes,c.total,
      CASE p.expected_side WHEN 'LONG' THEN c.long_hits ELSE c.short_hits END AS hits,
      a.score_sum/NULLIF(a.denominator,0) AS unrounded_average
    FROM proofs p LEFT JOIN averages a ON (a.consumer_version,a.snapshot_set_id,a.symbol)=
      (p.consumer_version,p.snapshot_set_id,p.symbol) AND a.source_side=p.expected_side
    LEFT JOIN consensus c ON (c.consumer_version,c.snapshot_set_id,c.symbol)=
      (p.consumer_version,p.snapshot_set_id,p.symbol)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS side_profiles,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'validation_status'='VALID') AS valid_profiles,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'validation_status'='UNAVAILABLE') AS unavailable_profiles,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'source_side' IS DISTINCT FROM expected_side) AS wrong_source_direction,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'validation_status'='VALID' AND (
    slots IS DISTINCT FROM 7::bigint OR source_rows IS DISTINCT FROM 7::bigint
    OR distinct_timeframes IS DISTINCT FROM 7::bigint OR missing<>0
    OR (proof->>'denominator')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM denominator
    OR jsonb_array_length(proof->'inactive_timeframes') IS DISTINCT FROM inactive::int
    OR proof->'timeframe_values' IS DISTINCT FROM timeframe_values
    OR ABS((proof->>'score_sum')::double precision-score_sum)>1e-9)) AS bad_active_denominator_or_values,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'validation_status'='VALID' AND (
    (proof->>'rounded_average') IS NULL OR ABS((proof->>'rounded_average')::double precision-unrounded_average)>0.005000001
    OR features->>'max_pain.average_score_all_timeframes' IS DISTINCT FROM proof->>'rounded_average')) AS bad_average,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'validation_status'='VALID' AND
    (proof->>'rounded_average')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM ROUND(unrounded_average::numeric,2)) AS pg_rounded_differences_check_python_if_nonzero,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'validation_status'='VALID' AND (
    (proof->>'consensus_hits')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM hits
    OR (proof->>'consensus_total')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM total
    OR (features->>'max_pain.consensus_hits_full')::boolean IS DISTINCT FROM (hits=total)
    OR (features->>'event.direction_mapping_valid')::boolean IS DISTINCT FROM true)) AS bad_consensus_or_mapping,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'validation_status'='UNAVAILABLE' AND
    (features ? 'event.direction_mapping_valid' OR features ? 'max_pain.average_score_all_timeframes'
      OR features ? 'max_pain.opposite_average_score_all_timeframes' OR features ? 'max_pain.consensus_hits_full')) AS unavailable_leaked_features,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'validation_status'='VALID' AND
    proof#>>'{opposite_coverage,validation_status}'='VALID' AND
    features->>'max_pain.opposite_average_score_all_timeframes' IS DISTINCT FROM
      proof#>>'{opposite_coverage,rounded_average}') AS bad_opposite_average
FROM joined

WITH sample AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v2-maxpain' AND status='READY'
    ORDER BY snapshot_set_id DESC,symbol LIMIT 512
), identity AS (
    SELECT f.*,i.bundle_sha256,i.parent_payload_sha256,i.observed_at_utc,
      a.source_metadata#>>'{capture_metadata,operational_scores,payload_sha256}' AS archive_bundle_sha256,
      a.payload_sha256 AS archive_parent_sha256
    FROM sample f JOIN research_watch_scan_intakes i USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
    JOIN research_max_pain_snapshot_sets a USING(snapshot_set_id)
), directions AS (
    SELECT f.symbol,e.value,c.orientation
    FROM sample f CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(f.payload->'evaluations') e
    LEFT JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_catalog c ON c.evaluation_version=f.evaluation_version
      AND c.candidate_key=e.value->>'candidate_key' AND c.supported
), quotes AS (
    SELECT f.symbol,i.observed_at_utc,p.key AS base_direction,p.value->>'validation_status' AS validation_status,
      q.value AS quote
    FROM sample f JOIN research_watch_scan_intakes i USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(f.payload->'maxpain_provenance_by_direction') p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(p.value->'source_quotes_by_timeframe') q
), source_target_checks AS (
    SELECT f.symbol,s.value->>'source_side' AS source_side,
      (s.value->>'target_price')::numeric AS frozen_target,
      (r.value->>'current_price')::numeric AS current_price,
      CASE s.value->>'source_side' WHEN 'SHORT' THEN (r.value->>'short_max_pain')::numeric
        ELSE (r.value->>'long_max_pain')::numeric END AS original_target
    FROM sample f JOIN research_watch_scan_observations o USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(o.maxpain_slots) s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(o.sources->'maxpain_operational_rows') r
    WHERE s.value->>'status'='SCORED' AND s.value->>'timeframe'=r.value->>'timeframe'
      AND f.payload#>>ARRAY['maxpain_provenance_by_direction',
        CASE s.value->>'source_side' WHEN 'SHORT' THEN 'LONG' ELSE 'SHORT' END,
        'validation_status']='VALID'
)
SELECT 'identity' AS section,jsonb_build_object('samples',COUNT(*),'violations',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
  payload->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM evaluation_version
  OR payload->>'feature_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'watch-captured-total-and-maxpain-features-v2'
  OR payload->>'bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bundle_sha256
  OR payload->>'parent_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM parent_payload_sha256
  OR bundle_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM archive_bundle_sha256
  OR parent_payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM archive_parent_sha256
  OR (payload->>'source_observed_at_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM observed_at_utc
  OR (payload->>'usable_from_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc
  OR jsonb_array_length(payload->'evaluations') IS DISTINCT FROM 164
  OR (payload->>'feature_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS DISTINCT FROM true)) AS evidence
FROM identity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'evaluation_directions',jsonb_build_object('rows',COUNT(*),'violations',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
  orientation IS NULL OR (value->>'base_direction' IN('LONG','SHORT')) IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR value->>'analysis_direction' IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN orientation='INVERSE'
    THEN CASE value->>'base_direction' WHEN 'LONG' THEN 'SHORT' ELSE 'LONG' END
    ELSE value->>'base_direction' END))
FROM directions
UNION ALL
SELECT 'valid_source_times',jsonb_build_object('quotes',COUNT(*),'violations',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
  (quote->>'source_observed_at_utc')::timestamptz>observed_at_utc
  OR (quote->>'price_fetched_at_utc')::timestamptz>observed_at_utc
  OR quote->>'source_observed_at_utc' IS NULL OR quote->>'price_fetched_at_utc' IS NULL))
FROM quotes WHERE validation_status='VALID'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'valid_target_price_binding',jsonb_build_object('slots',COUNT(*),
  'hype_slots',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE symbol='HYPE'),'violations',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    frozen_target IS DISTINCT FROM original_target OR current_price IS NULL OR current_price<=0
    OR original_target IS NULL OR original_target<=0
    OR (source_side='SHORT' AND original_target<=current_price)
    OR (source_side='LONG' AND original_target>=current_price)))
FROM source_target_checks
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hype_quote_contracts',jsonb_build_object('contracts',jsonb_agg(DISTINCT
  jsonb_build_object('source',quote->'price_source','pair',quote->'price_pair',
    'market',quote->'price_market','instrument',quote->'price_instrument')))
FROM quotes WHERE symbol='HYPE'
